release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the page states 1080P, 2.4GHz 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi, two-way audio, DC 5V / 1A over Type-C, H.264, infrared and spotlight night lighting, -10 to 45 C operating temperature, microSD up to 128GB and optional cloud storage; it is an indoor home camera.
